Over the hood, there is a voluminous, translucent blue wig or hairpiece made of synthetic-looking fibers. The doll is holding a clear, faceted object (possibly plastic or glass) in its hands.

The mouth area appears slightly melted or indistinct, lacking clear definition between lips and chin, common in AI-generated dolls.
The fingers holding the clear object appear somewhat fused and lack distinct joint articulation, suggesting minor structural generation issues.
